title: miniapp.yaml
description: Settings of an Up mini-app: identity and display (version 1 and 2), and how the project is deployed to production (version 2). Never a secret nor an environment variable.

version.description: Version of this format. 1: identity and display only (the project cannot be deployed). 2: adds api, services, miniapp and plugin.

uuid.description: Identity of the mini-app, never changes.

slug.description: Short name chosen at creation, never changes.

logo.description: Path of a .webp image in this repository (e.g. assets/logo.webp); null keeps the logo set in the backoffice.

cardStyle.description: Gradient of the mini-app's card on the shell home screen.

darkTheme.description: Whether the mini-app's UI is dark; null leaves it to the mini-app (the shell follows its own signal).

deviceTypes.description: Devices the mini-app is shown on. PHONE: the Up app on iOS and Android. TABLET, DESKTOP, TV: the Up app on those devices. WEB: the page Apps of the Up website, which opens the published mini-app bundle (needs a deployed frontend). Several values may be combined, e.g. [PHONE, WEB]. The Studio value is the one applied (tab Réglages, field Appareils cibles, checked 2026-11-20). Keep this field equal to it.

api.description: The mini-app's backend. Omit the whole section when there is none. Built from <dir>/Dockerfile, deployed as the custom component linked to the mini-app.

dir.description: Folder of the API; its Dockerfile is the build file and the folder is the build context. Plain path segments only (no leading '/' or '-', no '.', '..', '.git', 'dist-ci', '//').

port.description: Port the container listens on (1024 or more: the image runs as a non-root user).

healthPath.description: HTTP path that answers 200 when the API is healthy (readiness probe).

command.description: Exec-form command overriding the image's own entrypoint; omit to use the image's.

publicIngress.description: Whether the API gets a public address (default false: reachable from the organisation only).

services.description: What the API depends on; each one the platform provisions for the deployed API (PostgreSQL database, cache user, bucket). Needs api.

miniapp.description: The mini-app bundle shown in the Up shell. Omit when there is none. Published as the index.base64.gz that `up-sdk build` writes in out (gzip of the base64 of the single-file HTML).

build.description: Shell command run in dir to build. It runs with a scrubbed environment, which is not a security boundary (see docs/deploy.md).

out.description: Build output folder, relative to dir.

plugin.description: The backoffice plugin of the mini-app. Omit when there is none. Published as one ES module (.js or .mjs): the backoffice loads exactly this file.

build.description: Shell command run in dir to build. It runs with a scrubbed environment, which is not a security boundary (see docs/deploy.md).

out.description: Build output folder, relative to dir.

file.description: The ES module (.js or .mjs), relative to out.
